# cargocrypt

> Zero-config file encryption for Rust projects — ChaCha20-Poly1305 + Argon2id, git hooks for secret detection, TUI. Not yet audited.

cargocrypt is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/cargocrypt/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/cargocrypt): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install cargocrypt
```
